##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 21 August 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the Atlantic extends a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

Northerly 2 to 4, increasing 4 or 5 in the west this evening, becoming 3 to 5 in all waters overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Showers in the south at first, becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 3 to 5, decreasing 2 to 4 tomorrow afternoon, becoming Variable in places.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first, becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
